<table><tr><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">BSW Module</td><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">BSW Context</td></tr><tr><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">Dcm</td><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">Dcm/DcmConfigSet/DcmDsp/DcmDspData</td></tr><tr><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">BSW Parameter</td><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">BSW Type</td></tr><tr><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">DcmDspDidDataSupportInfo</td><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">ECUC-PARAM-CONF-CONTAINER-DEF</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">BSW Description</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">This container defines the supported information.</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">Template Description</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">DiagnosticParameter.supportInfo:This attribute represents the ability to define which bit of the support info byte is representing this part of the PID.DiagnosticDataldentifier.supportInfoByte:This attribute represents the supported information associated with the DiagnosticDataldentifier.</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">M2 Parameter</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">DiagnosticParameter.supportInfo,DiagnosticDataIdentifier.supportInfoByte</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">Mapping Rule</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">1:1 mapping</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">Mapping Status</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">valid</td></tr><tr><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">Dcm</td><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">Dcm/DcmConfigSet/DcmDsp/DcmDspData/DcmDspExternalSRDataElementClass/DcmDataElementInstance</td></tr><tr><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">BSW Parameter</td><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">BSW Type</td></tr><tr><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">DcmDataElementInstanceRef</td><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">ECUC-INSTANCE-REFERENCE-DEF</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">BSW Description</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">Instance Reference to the primitive or array data which shall be read or written. Thisreference is applicable if the AutosarDataPrototype is typed with a ApplicationPrimitiveDataType of category VALUE orBOOLEAN or ApplicationArrayDataType or if the AutosarDataPrototype is typed with a ImplementationDataType of categoryVALUE, ARRAY or TYPE_REFERENCE that in turn boils down to VALUE or ARRAY</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">Template Description</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">DiagnosticServiceDataMapping.mappedDataElement:This represents the dataElement in the application software that is accessed for diagnostic purpose. This role is applicable onthe classic platform.DiagnosticEnvDataElementCondition:This meta-class represents the ability to formulate a diagnostic environment condition based on the value of a data elementowned by the application software</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">M2 Parameter</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">DiagnosticServiceDataMapping.mappedDataElement,DiagnosticEnvDataElementCondition</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">Mapping Rule</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">DiagnosticServiceDataMapping maps to a primitive data.</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">Mapping Status</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">valid</td></tr></table>

<table><tr><td>DcmSubElementInImplDataElementInstanceRef</td><td colspan="2">ECUC-INSTANCE-REFERENCE-DEF</td></tr><tr><td colspan="3">BSW Description</td></tr><tr><td colspan="3">Instance Reference to the primitve sub-element (at any level) of composite data in a port which shall be read. Mapping Status</td><td></td><td>ECUC Parameter ID</td></tr><tr><td>valid</td><td></td><td>[ECUC_Dcm_00992]</td></tr></table>

By this means it is possible to create a primitive version of a TexttableMapping (which can only beapplied if a dataElement already exists).In other words, the DcmDspTextTableMapping provides a similar mechanism to the TexttableMapping in a situation where theTexttableMapping cannot be applied since the SenderReceiverInterface for the PortPrototype on the Dcm ServiceComponentdoes not yet exist.</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Template Description</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>This meta-class represents the ability to express the relationship between a physical value and the mathematicalrepresentation.Note that this is still independent of the technical implementation in data types. <table><tr><td>DcmDspTextTableMapping</td><td colspan="2">ECUC-PARAM-CONF-CONTAINER-DEF</td></tr><tr><td colspan="3">BSW Description The purpose of the DcmDspTextTableMapping is to associate a texttable value defined in the context of the Dcm to a texttable</td></tr><tr><td colspan="3">value defined in the context of a CompuMethod referenced by a DataType that shall be taken to create a dataElement in a SenderReceiverlnterface. By this means it is possible to create a primitive version of a TexttableMapping (which can only be applied if a dataElement already exists). In other words, the DcmDspTextTableMapping provides a similar mechanism to the TexttableMapping in a situation where the TexttableMapping cannot be applied since the SenderReceiverInterface for the PortPrototype on the Dcm ServiceComponent</td></tr><tr><td colspan="3">does not yet exist. Template Description</td></tr><tr><td colspan="3">This meta-class represents the ability to express the relationship between a physical value and the mathematical representation.</td></tr><tr><td colspan="3">Note that this is still independent of the technical implementation in data types. It only specifies the formula how the internal value corresponds to its physical pendant.</td></tr><tr><td colspan="3">M2 Parameter CompuMethod</td></tr><tr><td colspan="3">Mapping Rule</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2">This mapping applies if the CompuMethod.category is set to values TEXTTABLE or SCALE_</td><td>Mapping Type full</td></tr><tr><td colspan="3">LINEAR_AND_TEXTTABLE.</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2">Mapping Status</td><td>ECUC Parameter ID [ECUC_Dcm_00999]</td></tr><tr><td colspan="3">valid</td></tr></table>

<table><tr><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">BSW Module</td><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">BSW Context</td></tr><tr><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">Dcm</td><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">Dcm/DcmConfigSet/DcmDsp/DcmDspRoutine/DcmDspRequestRoutineResults/DcmDspRequestRoutineResultsOut/DcmDspRequestRoutineResultsOutSignalCompositePool/DcmDspRequestRoutineResultsOutSignal/DcmDspArgumentScaling/DcmDspAlternativeDataType</td></tr><tr><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">BSW Parameter</td><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">BSW Type</td></tr><tr><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">DcmDspTextTableMapping</td><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">ECUC-PARAM-CONF-CONTAINER-DEF</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">BSW Description</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">The purpose of the DcmDspTextTableMapping is to associate a texttable value defined in the context of the Dcm to a texttablevalue defined in the context of a CompuMethod referenced by a DataType that shall be taken to create a dataElement in aSenderReceiverlnterface. By this means it is possible to create a primitive version of a TexttableMapping (which can only beapplied if a dataElement already exists).In other words, the DcmDspTextTableMapping provides a similar mechanism to the TexttableMapping in a situation where theTexttableMapping cannot be applied since the SenderReceiverlnterface for the PortPrototype on the Dcm ServiceComponentdoes not yet exist</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">Template Description</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">This meta-class represents the ability to express the relationship between a physical value and the mathematicalrepresentation.Note that this is still independent of the technical implementation in data types. It only specifies the formula how the internalvalue corresponds to its physical pendant.</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">M2 Parameter</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">CompuMethod</td></tr><tr><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">Mapping Rule</td><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">Mapping Type</td></tr><tr><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">This mapping applies if the CompuMethod.category is set to values TEXTTABLE or SCALELINEAR AND TEXTTABLE.</td><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">full</td></tr><tr><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">Mapping Status</td><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">ECUC Parameter ID</td></tr><tr><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">valid</td><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">[ECUC_Dcm_00999]</td></tr></table>

The accumulated value represents a bitfield that has a bit set for each DiagnosticAuthRole.bitPosition.</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">Mapping Status</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">valid</td></tr><tr><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">Dcm</td><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">Dcm/DcmConfigSet/DcmDsp/DcmDspRoutine</td></tr><tr><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">BSW Parameter</td><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">BSW Type</td></tr><tr><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">DcmDspRoutineldentifier</td><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">ECUC-INTEGER-PARAM-DEF</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">BSW Description</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">2 bytes Identifier of the RIDWithin each DcmConfigSet all DcmDspRoutineldentifier values shall be unique.</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">Template Description</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">This is the numerical identifier used to identify the DiagnosticRoutine in the scope of diagnostic workflow</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">M2 Parameter</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">DiagnosticRoutine.id</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">Mapping Rule</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">1:1 mapping</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">Mapping Status</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">valid</td></tr></table>

<table><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Module</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Context</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>Dcm</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>Dcm/DcmConfigSet/DcmDsp/DcmDspRoutine</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Parameter</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Type</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>DcmDspRoutineUsePort</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>ECUC-BOOLEAN-PARAM-DEF</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>BSW Description</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>If this parameter is set to true, the DCM uses a port requiring a PortInterface RoutineServices_{RoutineName}.The R-Port is named RoutineServices_{RoutineName} where {RoutineName} is the name of the container DcmDspRoutineIn that case, the configuration must not provide function names in DcmDspStartRoutineFnc, DcmDspStopRoutineFnc or DcmDspRequestResultsRoutineFnc. If this is false, the DCM expects to find the names of the functions to be used in DcmDspStartRoutineFnc, DcmDspStopRoutineFnc or DcmDspRequestResultsRoutineFnc.</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Template Description</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>This represents the ability to define a mapping of a diagnostic service to a software-component or a basic-software module. Ifthe former is used then this kind of service mapping is applicable for the usage of ClientServerlnterfaces.</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>M2 Parameter</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>DiagnosticServiceSwMapping</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Mapping Rule</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>TRUE: DiagnosticServiceSwMapping is having a SwcServiceDependencyFALSE: DiagnosticServiceSwMapping is having a BswServiceDependency</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Mapping Status</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>valid</td></tr></table>

<table><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Module</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Context</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>Dcm</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>Dcm/DcmConfigSet/DcmDsp/DcmDspRoutine</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Parameter</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Type</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>DcmDspStartRoutine</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>ECUC-PARAM-CONF-CONTAINER-DEF</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>BSW Description</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Provides the configuration of Start subservice for RoutineControl service.</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Template Description</td></tr></table>

<table><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>DiagnosticRoutine.start:This represents the ability to start a routineDiagnosticRoutineNeeds:Specifies the general needs on the configuration of the Diagnostic Communication Manager (Dcm) which are not related to aparticular item (e.g. a PID). By this means it is possible to create a primitive version of a TexttableMapping (which can only beapplied if a dataElement already exists).In other words, the DcmDspTextTableMapping provides a similar mechanism to the TexttableMapping in a situation where theTexttableMapping cannot be applied since the SenderReceiverInterface for the PortPrototype on the Dcm ServiceComponentdoes not yet exist.</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Template Description</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>This meta-class represents the ability to express the relationship between a physical value and the mathematicalrepresentation.Note that this is still independent of the technical implementation in data types. <table><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>BSW Description</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Provide description of a routine signal used in RoutineControl service.The ordering defined via the index attribute of the subcontainers in this list represents the order of the dataOutN elements inthe XXX_Start function call.</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Template Description</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>This represents the related dataElement of the DiagnosticParameter</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>M2 Parameter</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>DiagnosticAbstractParameter.dataElement</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>Mapping Rule</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>Mapping Type</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>1:1 mapping</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>full</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>Mapping Status</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>ECUC Parameter ID</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>valid</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>[ECUC_Dcm_00848]</td></tr></table>

<table><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Module</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Context</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>Dcm</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>Dcm/DcmConfigSet/DcmDsp/DcmDspRoutine/DcmDspStartRoutine/DcmDspStartRoutineOut/DcmDspStartRoutineOutSignal/DcmDspArgumentScaling/DcmDspAlternativeDataType</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Parameter</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Type</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>DcmDspTextTableMapping</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>ECUC-PARAM-CONF-CONTAINER-DEF</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>BSW Description</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>The purpose of the DcmDspTextTableMapping is to associate a texttable value defined in the context of the Dcm to a texttablevalue defined in the context of a CompuMethod referenced by a DataType that shall be taken to create a dataElement in aSenderReceiverlnterface. By this means it is possible to create a primitive version of a TexttableMapping (which can only beapplied if a dataElement already exists).In other words, the DcmDspTextTableMapping provides a similar mechanism to the TexttableMapping in a situation where theTexttableMapping cannot be applied since the SenderReceiverInterface for the PortPrototype on the Dcm ServiceComponentdoes not yet exist.</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Template Description</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>This meta-class represents the ability to express the relationship between a physical value and the mathematicalrepresentation.Note that this is still independent of the technical implementation in data types. It only specifies the formula how the internalvalue corresponds to its physical pendant.</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>M2 Parameter</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>CompuMethod</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Mapping Rule</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>This mapping applies if the CompuMethod.category is set to values TEXTTABLE or SCALE_LINEAR_AND_TEXTTABLE.</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Mapping Status</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>valid</td></tr></table>

<table><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Module</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Context</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>Dcm</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>Dcm/DcmConfigSet/DcmDsp/DcmDspRoutine/DcmDspStartRoutine/DcmDspStartRoutineOut/DcmDspStartRoutineOutSignalCompositePool/DcmDspStartRoutineOutSignal/DcmDspArgumentScaling/DcmDspAlternativeDataType</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Parameter</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Type</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>DcmDspTextTableMapping</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>ECUC-PARAM-CONF-CONTAINER-DEF</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>BSW Description</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>The purpose of the DcmDspTextTableMapping is to associate a texttable value defined in the context of the Dcm to a texttablevalue defined in the context of a CompuMethod referenced by a DataType that shall be taken to create a dataElement in aSenderReceiverlnterface. By this means it is possible to create a primitive version of a TexttableMapping (which can only beapplied if a dataElement already exists).In other words, the DcmDspTextTableMapping provides a similar mechanism to the TexttableMapping in a situation where theTexttableMapping cannot be applied since the SenderReceiverlnterface for the PortPrototype on the Dcm ServiceComponentdoes not yet exist.</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Template Description</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>This meta-class represents the ability to express the relationship between a physical value and the mathematicalrepresentation.Note that this is still independent of the technical implementation in data types. It only specifies the formula how the internalvalue corresponds to its physical pendant.</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>M2 Parameter</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>CompuMethod</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Mapping Rule</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>This mapping applies if the CompuMethod.category is set to values TEXTTABLE or SCALE_LINEAR_AND_TEXTTABLE.</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Mapping Status</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>valid</td></tr></table>

Existence indicates that the StopRoutine in theRoutineControl is supported.</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Template Description</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>DiagnosticRoutine.stop:This represents the ability to stop a running routine.DiagnosticRoutineNeeds.diagRoutineType:This denotes the type of diagnostic routine which is implemented by the referenced server port.</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>M2 Parameter</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>DiagnosticRoutine.stop,DiagnosticRoutineNeeds.diagRoutineType</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Mapping Rule</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>1:1 mapping for DiagnosticRoutine.stopORDiagnosticRoutineNeeds.diagRoutineType == asynchronous</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Mapping Status</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>valid</td></tr></table>

<table><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Module</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Context</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>Dcm</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>Dcm/DcmConfigSet/DcmDsp/DcmDspRoutine/DcmDspStopRoutine</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Parameter</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Type</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>DcmDspStopRoutineln</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>ECUC-PARAM-CONF-CONTAINER-DEF</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>BSW Description</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Provide description of input parameter of Stop subservice for RoutineControl service.</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Template Description</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>This represents the request parameters.</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>M2 Parameter</td></tr></table>

<table><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>DiagnosticStopRoutine.request</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>Mapping Rule</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>Mapping Type</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>1:1 mapping</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>full</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>Mapping Status</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>ECUC Parameter ID</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>valid</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>[ECUC_Dcm_00832]</td></tr></table>

<table><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Module</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Context</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>Dcm</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>Dcm/DcmConfigSet/DcmDsp/DcmDspRoutine/DcmDspStopRoutine/DcmDspStopRoutineln</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Parameter</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Type</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>DcmDspStopRoutinelnSignal</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>ECUC-PARAM-CONF-CONTAINER-DEF</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>BSW Description</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Provide description of a routine signal used in RoutineControl service.The ordering defined via the index attribute of the subcontainers in this list represents the order of the datalnN elements inthe XXX_Stop function call.</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Template Description</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>This represents the related dataElement of the DiagnosticParameter</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>M2 Parameter</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>DiagnosticAbstractParameter.dataElement</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Mapping Rule</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>1:1 mapping</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Mapping Status</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>valid</td></tr></table>

<table><tr><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">BSW Module</td><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">BSW Context</td></tr><tr><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">Dcm</td><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">Dcm/DcmConfigSet/DcmDsp/DcmDspRoutine/DcmDspStopRoutine/DcmDspStopRoutineln/DcmDspStopRoutinelnSignal/DcmDspArgumentScaling/DcmDspAlternativeDataType</td></tr><tr><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">BSW Parameter</td><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">BSW Type</td></tr><tr><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">DcmDspTextTableMapping</td><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">ECUC-PARAM-CONF-CONTAINER-DEF</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">BSW Description</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">The purpose of the DcmDspTextTableMapping is to associate a texttable value defined in the context of the Dcm to a texttablevalue defined in the context of a CompuMethod referenced by a DataType that shall be taken to create a dataElement in aSenderReceiverlnterface. By this means it is possible to create a primitive version of a TexttableMapping (which can only beapplied if a dataElement already exists).In other words, the DcmDspTextTableMapping provides a similar mechanism to the TexttableMapping in a situation where theTexttableMapping cannot be applied since the SenderReceiverInterface for the PortPrototype on the Dcm ServiceComponentdoes not yet exist.</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">Template Description</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">This meta-class represents the ability to express the relationship between a physical value and the mathematicalrepresentation.Note that this is still independent of the technical implementation in data types. <table><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>DcmDspStopRoutinelnSignal</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>ECUC-PARAM-CONF-CONTAINER-DEF</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>BSW Description</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Provide description of a routine signal used in RoutineControl service.The ordering defined via the index attribute of the subcontainers in this list represents the order of the datalnN elements inthe XXX_Stop function call.</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Template Description</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>This represents the related dataElement of the DiagnosticParameter</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>M2 Parameter</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>DiagnosticAbstractParameter.dataElement</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Mapping Rule</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>1:1 mapping</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Mapping Status</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>valid</td></tr></table>

<table><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Module</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Context</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>Dcm</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>Dcm/DcmConfigSet/DcmDsp/DcmDspRoutine/DcmDspStopRoutine/DcmDspStopRoutineln/DcmDspStopRoutinelnSignalCompositePool/DcmDspStopRoutinelnSignal/DcmDspArgumentScaling/DcmDspAlternativeDataType</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Parameter</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Type</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>DcmDspTextTableMapping</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>ECUC-PARAM-CONF-CONTAINER-DEF</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>BSW Description</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>The purpose of the DcmDspTextTableMapping is to associate a texttable value defined in the context of the Dcm to a texttablevalue defined in the context of a CompuMethod referenced by a DataType that shall be taken to create a dataElement in aSenderReceiverlnterface. By this means it is possible to create a primitive version of a TexttableMapping (which can only beapplied if a dataElement already exists).In other words, the DcmDspTextTableMapping provides a similar mechanism to the TexttableMapping in a situation where theTexttableMapping cannot be applied since the SenderReceiverlInterface for the PortPrototype on the Dcm ServiceComponentdoes not yet exist.</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Template Description</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>This meta-class represents the ability to express the relationship between a physical value and the mathematicalrepresentation.Note that this is still independent of the technical implementation in data types. It only specifies the formula how the internalvalue corresponds to its physical pendant.</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>M2 Parameter</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>CompuMethod</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Mapping Rule</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>This mapping applies if the CompuMethod.category is set to values TEXTTABLE or SCALE_LINEAR_AND_TEXTTABLE.</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Mapping Status</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>valid</td></tr></table>

<table><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Module</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Context</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>Dcm</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>Dcm/DcmConfigSet/DcmDsp/DcmDspSession/DcmDspSessionRow</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Parameter</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Type</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>DcmDspSessionP2ServerMax</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>ECUC-FLOAT-PARAM-DEF</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>BSW Description</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>This is the session value for P2ServerMax in seconds (per Session). This value is reported to the tester within theresponse to the &#x27;Session Control&#x27; service.</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Template Description</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>This is the session value for P2ServerMax in seconds (per Session Control).The AUTOSAR configuration standard is to use SI units, so this parameter is defined as a float value in seconds.</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>M2 Parameter</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>DiagnosticSession.p2ServerMax</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Mapping Rule</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>1:1 mapping</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Mapping Status</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>valid</td></tr></table>

<table><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Module</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Context</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>Dcm</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>Dcm/DcmConfigSet/DcmDsp/DcmDspVehInfo</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Parameter</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Type</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>DcmDspVehInfoData</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>ECUC-PARAM-CONF-CONTAINER-DEF</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>BSW Description</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Data Item of an InfoType; ShortName is post-fix of the port interface name.</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Template Description</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>This meta-class represents the ability to describe a concrete piece of data to be taken into account for diagnostic purposes.</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>M2 Parameter</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>DiagnosticDataElement</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Mapping Rule</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>The value shall be taken from DiagnosticRequestVehiclelnfo.infoType.dataElement.dataElement.</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Mapping Status</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>valid</td></tr></table>

<table><tr><td colspan="3">Defines the order of the data item in the InfoType; values: 0..255; first data item having the order number 0; the next 1 and so on. The configuration of order needs to be unique per InfoType.</td></tr><tr><td colspan="3">Template Description</td></tr><tr><td colspan="3">This represents the bitOffset of the DiagnosticParameter. The value of the bitOffset shall always be interpreted as relative to the start of the enclosing DiagnosticDataldentifier, DiagnosticParameterldentifier, or DiagnosticRoutineSubfunction.</td></tr><tr><td colspan="3">M2 Parameter</td></tr><tr><td>DiagnosticParameter.bitOffset</td><td colspan="2"></td></tr><tr><td>Mapping Rule</td><td></td><td>Mapping Type</td></tr><tr><td>Value shall be taken from DiagnosticRequestVehiclelnfo.infoType.dataElement.bitOffset.</td><td></td><td>full</td></tr><tr><td>Mapping Status</td><td></td><td>ECUC Parameter ID</td></tr><tr><td>valid</td><td></td><td>[ECUC_Dcm_00891]</td></tr></table>

<table><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Module</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Context</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>Dcm</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>Dcm/DcmConfigSet/DcmDsp/DcmDspVehInfo/DcmDspVehInfoData</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Parameter</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Type</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>DcmDspVehInfoDataReadFnc</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>ECUC-FUNCTION-NAME-DEF</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>BSW Description</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Callout function name for reading InfoType data item. Only required in case parameter &#x27;DcmDspVehInfoDataUsePort&#x27; is set to&#x27;false&#x27;</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Template Description</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>This is supposed to represent a reference to a BswServiceDependency. the latter is not derived from Referrable andtherefore this detour needs to be implemented to still let BswServiceDependency become the target of a reference.</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>M2 Parameter</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>DiagnosticServiceSwMapping.mappedBswServiceDependency</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Mapping Rule</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>The BswServiceDependency should have aRoleBasedBswModuleEntryAssignment that in turnhas attribute role set to Xxx_GetInfotypeValueData and points to a BswModuleEntry.</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Mapping Status</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>valid</td></tr></table>

<table><tr><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">BSW Module</td><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">BSW Context</td></tr><tr><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">Dcm</td><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">Dcm/DcmConfigSet/DcmDsp/DcmDspVehInfo/DcmDspVehInfoData</td></tr><tr><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">BSW Parameter</td><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">BSW Type</td></tr><tr><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">DcmDspVehInfoDataSize</td><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">ECUC-INTEGER-PARAM-DEF</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">BSW Description</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">Size in bytes of the InfoType data item.</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">Template Description</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">The existence of this attribute turns the data instance into an atrray of data. The attribute determines the size of the array interms of how many elements the array can take.</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">M2 Parameter</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">DiagnosticDataElement.maxNumberOfElements</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">Mapping Rule</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">Value shall be taken from DiagnosticRequestVehiclelnfo.infoType.dataElement.dataElement.maxNumberOfElements.</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">Mapping Status</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">valid</td></tr><tr><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">DcmDspVehInfoDataUsePort</td><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">ECUC-BOOLEAN-PARAM-DEF</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">BSW Description</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">When this parameter is set to true the DCM will access the Data using an R-Port requiring a PortInterface IlnfotypeServices_{VehInfoData}. The R-Port is named InfotypeServices_{VehInfoData} where {VEHINFODATA} is the name of thecontainer DcmDspVehInfoData. In that case, the DcmDspVehInfoDataReadFnc is ignored and the RTE APIs are used.When this parameter is set to false, the DCM calls the function defined in DcmDspVehInfoDataReadFnc.</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">Template Description</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">DiagnosticServiceSwMapping.mappedBswServiceDependency:This is supposed to represent a reference to a BswServiceDependency. the latter is not derived from Referrable andtherefore this detour needs to be implemented to still let BswServiceDependency become the target of a reference.DiagnosticServiceSwMapping.mappedSwcServiceDependencyInSystem:This represents the ability to point into the component hierarchy (under possible consideration of the rootSoftwareComposition)</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">M2 Parameter</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">DiagnosticServiceSwMapping.mappedBswServiceDependency,DiagnosticServiceSwMapping.mappedSwcServiceDependencyInSystem</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">Mapping Rule</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">Shall be set to TRUE if the reference DiagnosticServiceSwMapping.mappedSwcServiceDependency exists. Shall be set to FALSE if the reference DiagnosticServiceSwMapping.mappedBswServiceDependency exists.</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">Mapping Status</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">valid</td></tr></table>

<table><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Module</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Context</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>Dcm</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>Dcm/DcmConfigSet/DcmDsp/DcmDspVehInfo</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Parameter</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Type</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>DcmDspVehInfolnfoType</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>ECUC-INTEGER-PARAM-DEF</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>BSW Description</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>value of InfoType.Within each DcmConfigSet all DcmDspVehInfolnfoType values shall be unique.</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Template Description</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>This attribute represents the value of InfoType (see SAE J1979-DA).</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>M2 Parameter</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>DiagnosticInfoType.id</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Mapping Rule</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>If DiagnosticRequestVehiclelnfo, us DiagnosticRequestVehiclelnfo.infoType.id.</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Mapping Status</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>valid</td></tr></table>

<table><tr><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">BSW Module</td><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">BSW Context</td></tr><tr><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">Dcm</td><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">Dcm/DcmConfigSet/DcmProcessingConditions</td></tr><tr><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">BSW Parameter</td><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">BSW Type</td></tr><tr><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">DcmModeCondition</td><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">ECUC-PARAM-CONF-CONTAINER-DEF</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">BSW Description</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">This container contains the configuration of a mode condition or an environmental conditions which can be used as argumentin DcmModeRules.One DcmModeCondition shall contain either one DcmSwcModeRef or one DcmBswModeRef or one DcmSwcSRDataElementRef.Please note that the Dcm acts as well as mode manager. Therefore the references DcmSwcModeRef or one DcmBswModeRef. might point to provided ModeDeclarationGroupPrototypes of the Dcm itself as well as to provided ModeDeclarationGroupPrototypes of other Bsw Modules or software components.In case of a configured DcmSwcModeRef or DcmBswModeRef only the DcmConditionType DCM_EQUALS or DCM_EQUALS_NOT are applicable.In case of DcmSwcSRDataElementRef all literals of DcmConditionType are possible.</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">Template Description</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">DiagnosticCompareConditions are atomic conditions. They are based on the idea of a comparison at runtime of somevariable data with something constant. The type of the comparison $( = = , \ l = , < , < = , \ \ldots )$ is specified in DiagnosticCompareCondition.compareType.</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">M2 Parameter</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">DiagnosticEnvCompareCondition</td></tr><tr><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">Mapping Rule</td><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">Mapping Type</td></tr><tr><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">Depending on the reference a DcmModeCondition is mapped to a DiagnosticEnvModeCondition ifonly one reference is present and reference is a DcmSwcModeRef or a DcmBswModeRef. If tworeferences are present, a DcmSwcSRDataElementRef and a DcmSwcSRDataElementValueRef,then DcmModeCondition is mapped to a DiagnosticEnvDataCondition.</td><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">full</td></tr><tr><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">Mapping Status</td><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">ECUC Parameter ID</td></tr><tr><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">valid</td><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">[ECUC_Dcm_00928]</td></tr></table>

<table><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Module</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Context</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>Dcm</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>Dcm/DcmConfigSet/DcmProcessingConditions/DcmModeCondition</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Parameter</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Type</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>DcmBswModeRef</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>ECUC-INSTANCE-REFERENCE-DEF</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>BSW Description</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>This parameter references a mode of a ModeDeclarationGroupPrototype provided by a Basic Software Module used for thecondition.Please note that such ModeDeclarationGroupPrototype are owned by a Basic Software Module Description in the roleprovidedModeGroup.</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Template Description</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>This reference represents both the ModeDeclarationGroupPrototype and the ModeDeclaration relevant for the modecomparison.</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>M2 Parameter</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>DiagnosticEnvModeCondition.modeElement</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Mapping Rule</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>For DcmModeRef a new DiagnosticEnvBswModeElement is used, pointing to the ModeDeclarationvia ModelnModuleDescriptionInstanceRef. This new DiagnosticEnvModeElement shall beaggregated by the same DiagnosticEnvironmentalConfition as the DiagnosticEnvModeCondition,in which the target of the reference DiagnosticEnvModeCondition.modeElement points to the thisDiagnosticEnvModeElement.</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Mapping Status</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>valid</td></tr></table>

<table><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Module</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Context</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>Dcm</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>Dcm/DcmConfigSet/DcmProcessingConditions/DcmModeCondition</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Parameter</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Type</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>DcmSwcModeRef</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>ECUC-INSTANCE-REFERENCE-DEF</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>BSW Description</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>This parameter references a mode in a particular mode request port of a software component that is used for the condition.</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Template Description</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>This reference represents both the ModeDeclarationGroupPrototype and the ModeDeclaration relevant for the modecomparison.</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>M2 Parameter</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>DiagnosticEnvModeCondition.modeElement</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Mapping Rule</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>For DcmModeRef a new DiagnosticEnvSwcModeElement is used, pointing to the ModeDeclarationvia PModelnSystemInstanceRef. This new DiagnosticEnvModeElement shall be aggregated by thesame DiagnosticEnvironmentalConfition as the DiagnosticEnvModeCondition, in which the targetof the reference DiagnosticEnvModeCondition.modeElement points to the this DiagnosticEnvModeElement.</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Mapping Status</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>valid</td></tr></table>

<table><tr><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">BSW Module</td><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">BSW Context</td></tr><tr><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">Dcm</td><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">Dcm/DcmConfigSet/DcmProcessingConditions/DcmModeCondition</td></tr><tr><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">BSW Parameter</td><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">BSW Type</td></tr><tr><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">DcmSwcSRDataElementRef</td><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">ECUC-CHOICE-REFERENCE-DEF</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">BSW Description</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">Reference to environmental conditions. It is possible to reference a S/R Receiver-Port to read physical values and compare(equal, greater, less,...) them with a configured value that is defined by DcmSwcDataElementValue.</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">Template Description</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">This reference represents the related diagnostic data element.</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">M2 Parameter</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">DiagnosticEnvDataCondition.dataElement</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">Mapping Rule</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">1:1 mapping</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">Mapping Status</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">valid</td></tr><tr><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">Dcm</td><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">Dcm/DcmConfigSet/DcmProcessingConditions</td></tr><tr><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">BSW Parameter</td><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">BSW Type</td></tr><tr><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">DcmModeRule</td><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">ECUC-PARAM-CONF-CONTAINER-DEF</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">BSW Description</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">This container contains the configuration of a mode rule which represents a logical expression with DcmModeConditions orother DcmModeRules as arguments.All arguments are processed with the operator defined by DcmLogicalOperator, for instance: Argument_A AND Argument_BAND Argument_C</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">Template Description</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">A DiagnosticEnvConditionFormula embodies the computation instruction that is to be evaluated at runtime to determine if theDiagnosticEnvironmentalCondition is currently present (i.e. the formula is evaluated to true) or not (otherwise). The formulaitself consists of parts which are combined by the logical operations specified by DiagnosticEnvConditionFormula.op.If a diagnostic functionality cannot be executed because an environmental condition fails then the diagnostic stack shall senda negative response code (NRC) back to the client. The value of the NRC is directly related to the specific formula and istherefore formalized in the attribute DiagnosticEnvConditionFormula.nrcValue.</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">M2 Parameter</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">DiagnosticEnvConditionFormula</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">Mapping Rule</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">A DcmModeRule is mapped to a DiagnosticEnvConditionFormula, if this DcmModeRule is asubrule, i.e. it is referenced by a DcmArgumentRef. In addition, a new DiagnosticEnvironmentalCondition shall be created with DiagnosticEnvironmentalCondition.formula containing a DiagnosticEnvConditionFormula. In both cases, if no DcmLogicalOperator is present in this DcmModeRule,then DiagnosticEnvConditionFormula shall be set to DiagnosticLogicalOperatorEnum.logicalAnd.</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">Mapping Status</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">valid</td></tr></table>

<table><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Module</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Context</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>Dcm</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>Dcm/DcmConfigSet/DcmProcessingConditions/DcmModeRule</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Parameter</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Type</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>DcmArgumentRef</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>ECUC-CHOICE-REFERENCE-DEF</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>BSW Description</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>This is a choice reference either to a mode condition or a an other mode rule serving as sub-expression.</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Template Description</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>A DiagnosticEnvConditionFormulaPart can either be a atomic condition, e.g. a DiagnosticEnvCompareCondition, or aDiagnosticEnvConditionFormula, again, which allows arbitrary nesting.</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>M2 Parameter</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>DiagnosticEnvConditionFormulaPart</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Mapping Rule</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Depending on the destination, one DcmArgumentRef is mapped to a DiagnosticEnvConditionFormula if &quot;destination&quot; is a DcmModeRule, and to a DiagnosticEnvCompareCondition, if&quot;destination&quot; is a DcmModeCondition. The order of the aggregation of the DiagnosticEnvConditionFormulaParts shall correspond to the ordering of the index of the DcmArgumentRefs.</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Mapping Status</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>valid</td></tr></table>

This value can be reported as internal data element in snapshotrecords or extended data records.</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">Template Description</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">This attribute represents the identification number that is associated with the enclosing DiagnosticEvent and allows to identifyit when placed into a snapshot record or extended data record storage.This value can be reported as internal data element in snapshot records or extended data records.</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">M2 Parameter</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">DiagnosticEvent.associatedEventIdentification</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">Mapping Rule</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">1:1 mapping</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">Mapping Status</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">valid</td></tr><tr><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">DemEventConfirmationThreshold</td><td colspan="1" rowspan="1">ECUC-INTEGER-PARAM-DEF</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">BSW Description</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">Defines the operation cycle threshold of the DTC confirmation status according "Confirmation Threshold" of ISO 14229-1.</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">Template Description</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">This attribute defines the number of operation cycles with a failed result before a confirmed DTC is set to 1. The semantic ofthis attribute is a by "1" increased value compared to the confirmation threshold of the "trip counter" mentioned in ISO14229-1 in figure D.4. A value of "1" defines the immediate confirmation of the DTC along with the first reported failed. This isalso sometimes called "zero trip DTC". A value of "2" defines a DTC confirmation in the operation cycle after the first occurredfailed. A value of "2" is typically used in the US for OBD DTC confirmation.</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">M2 Parameter</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">DiagnosticEvent.confirmationThreshold</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">Mapping Rule</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">1:1 mapping</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">Mapping Status</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" rowspan="1">valid</td></tr></table>

A possible solution could be assigning events as summarized events along with a list of specificevents. During the configuration process the summarized event substitutes the referenced single events.However, it is not outlined how this requirement is solved - whether by configuration process or by implementation within theFiM. The FiM configuration tool could also build up a suitable data structure for summarized events and deal with it in the FiMimplementation.</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Template Description</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>This meta-class represents the ability to model a Fim event group, also known as a summary event in Fim terminology. <table><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Module</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Context</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>J1939Dcm</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>J1939Dcm/J1939DcmConfigSet/J1939DcmProcessingConditions</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Parameter</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Type</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>J1939DcmModeCondition</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>ECUC-PARAM-CONF-CONTAINER-DEF</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>BSW Description</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>This container contains the configuration of a mode condition or an environmental conditions which can be used as argumentin J1939DcmModeRules.One J1939DcmModeCondition shall contain either one J1939DcmSwcModeRef or one J1939DcmBswModeRef or oneJ1939DcmSwcSRDataElementRef.Please note that the J1939Dcm acts as well as mode manager. Therefore the references J1939DcmSwcModeRef or oneJ1939DcmBswModeRef might point to provided ModeDeclarationGroupPrototypes of the J1939Dcm itself as well as toprovided ModeDeclarationGroupPrototypes of other Bsw Modules or software components.In case of a configured J1939DcmSwcModeRef or J1939DcmBswModeRef only the J1939DcmConditionType J1939DCM_EQUALS or J1939DCM_EQUALS_NOT are applicable.In case of J1939DcmSwcSRDataElementRef all literals of J1939DcmConditionType are possible.</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Template Description</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>DiagnosticCompareConditions are atomic conditions. They are based on the idea of a comparison at runtime of somevariable data with something constant. The type of the comparison $( = = , \ l = , < , < = , \ \ldots )$ is specified in DiagnosticCompareCondition.compareType.</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>M2 Parameter</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>DiagnosticEnvCompareCondition</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Mapping Rule</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Depending on the reference a DcmModeCondition is mapped to a DiagnosticEnvModeCondition ifonly one reference is present and reference is a DcmSwcModeRef or a DcmBswModeRef. If tworeferences are present, a DcmSwcSRDataElementRef and a DcmSwcSRDataElementValueRef,then DcmModeCondition is mapped to a DiagnosticEnvDataCondition.</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Mapping Status</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>valid</td></tr></table>

<table><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Module</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Context</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>J1939Dcm</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>J1939Dcm/J1939DcmConfigSet/J1939DcmProcessingConditions/J1939DcmModeCondition</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Parameter</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Type</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>J1939DcmBswModeRef</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>ECUC-INSTANCE-REFERENCE-DEF</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>BSW Description</td></tr></table>

<table><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>This parameter references a mode of a ModeDeclarationGroupPrototype provided by a Basic Software Module used for thecondition.Please note that such ModeDeclarationGroupPrototype are owned by a Basic Software Module Description in the roleprovidedModeGroup.</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Template Description</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>This reference represents both the ModeDeclarationGroupPrototype and the ModeDeclaration relevant for the modecomparison.</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>M2 Parameter</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>DiagnosticEnvModeCondition.modeElement</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>Mapping Rule</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>Mapping Type</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>For DcmModeRef a new DiagnosticEnvBswModeElement is used, pointing to the ModeDeclarationvia ModelnModuleDescriptionlnstanceRef. <table><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Module</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Context</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>J1939Dcm</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>J1939Dcm/J1939DcmConfigSet/J1939DcmProcessingConditions</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Parameter</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Type</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>J1939DcmModeRule</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>ECUC-PARAM-CONF-CONTAINER-DEF</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>BSW Description</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>This container contains the configuration of a mode rule which represents a logical expression with J1939DcmModeConditions or other J1939DcmModeRules as arguments.All arguments are processed with the operator defined by DcmLogicalOperator, for instance: Argument_A AND Argument_BAND Argument_C</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Template Description</td></tr></table>

<table><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>A DiagnosticEnvConditionFormula embodies the computation instruction that is to be evaluated at runtime to determine if theDiagnosticEnvironmentalCondition is currently present (i.e. the formula is evaluated to true) or not (otherwise). The formulaitself consists of parts which are combined by the logical operations specified by DiagnosticEnvConditionFormula.op.If a diagnostic functionality cannot be executed because an environmental condition fails then the diagnostic stack shall senda negative response code (NRC) back to the client. The value of the NRC is directly related to the specific formula and istherefore formalized in the attribute DiagnosticEnvConditionFormula.nrcValue.</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>M2 Parameter</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>DiagnosticEnvConditionFormula</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>Mapping Rule</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>Mapping Type</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>A DcmModeRule is mapped to a DiagnosticEnvConditionFormula, if this DcmModeRule is asubrule, i.e. it is referenced by a DcmArgumentRef. In addition, a new DiagnosticEnvironmentalCondition shall be created with DiagnosticEnvironmentalCondition.formula containing a DiagnosticEnvConditionFormula. In both cases, if no DcmLogicalOperator is present in this DcmModeRule,then DiagnosticEnvConditionFormula shall be set to DiagnosticLogicalOperatorEnum.logicalAnd.</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>full</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>Mapping Status</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>ECUC Parameter ID</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>valid</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>[ECUC_J1939Dcm_00053]</td></tr></table>

<table><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Module</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Context</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>J1939Dcm</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>J1939Dcm/J1939DcmConfigSet/J1939DcmProcessingConditions/J1939DcmModeRule</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Parameter</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>BSW Type</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>J1939DcmArgumentRef</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>ECUC-CHOICE-REFERENCE-DEF</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>BSW Description</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>This is a choice reference either to a mode condition or a an other mode rule serving as sub-expression.</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Template Description</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>A DiagnosticEnvConditionFormulaPart can either be a atomic condition, e.g. a DiagnosticEnvCompareCondition, or aDiagnosticEnvConditionFormula, again, which allows arbitrary nesting</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>M2 Parameter</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>DiagnosticEnvConditionFormulaPart</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Mapping Rule</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Depending on the destination, one DcmArgumentRef is mapped to a DiagnosticEnvConditionFormula if &quot;destination&quot; is a DcmModeRule, and to a DiagnosticEnvCompareCondition, if&quot;destination&quot; is a DcmModeCondition. The order of the aggregation of the DiagnosticEnvConditionFormulaParts shall correspond to the ordering of the index of the DcmArgumentRefs.</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>Mapping Status</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=2>valid</td></tr></table>
